## Summary

Describe the problem, what changed, and why. Link related issues when applicable.

## Verification

List the commands and manual scenarios you ran, their results, and any checks
you could not run. For desktop behavior changes, include the macOS version,
display setup, and observed result. Add redacted screenshots or a recording for
visible UI changes.

## Compatibility

Describe any impact on shortcuts, configuration, session state, or upgrades.
Write “None” if there is no user-visible compatibility change.

## Checklist

- [ ] The PR targets `main` and stays focused on the described change.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass, or unavailable checks are explained above.
- [ ] Behavior changes have appropriate regression coverage and a live check.
- [ ] Documentation and generated command help are updated where applicable.
- [ ] No unrelated formatting, built apps, credentials, or personal data are included.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/hancengiz/macarchy/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
for setup and contribution guidance. Mark non-applicable items in the description.
